meta.notes: A handling instruction more alarming than the object warrants. Named by a simile in Jonah's page; his gloves have no buttons. Comic engine: conservation ethics applied to what nobody wants.

threads.source: Bank lines; a quiet beat, and the one joke he tells against himself.
S09, B17. A scrap on a blotter. Cleared only for what it clears.

threads.topic: Those condition reports. Can I read July?
threads.source: Suspect chain, the Prices. Dated before the gap and clears nothing about it.

np_k1.line: They tell me it is of no practical value. That is the finest thing anyone has said about it. Please don't breathe on it. I don't mean it unkindly.

choices.label: You don't let people in much.

np_k2.line: I wrote six months of condition reports on that door. Hinges, draught, hours of use. The woman across the landing asked whether I had considered knocking on it. It has been written up.

np_g1.line: Not on the blotter. Who let you bring that in wet?

choices.label: Jonah says you've got white hands.

np_g2.line: Thank you. Kid. Glacé, French, a good cheap copy of a good dear glove. Pearl on a shank, sewn after, by a different hand. It has been pulled, you see, from there, in the direction the seam can't go. Those have buttons. Mine don't.

np_g3.line: They're still wet. I wear cotton, you'll note, with a tape closure, because a button marks. My brother has written a great many things about my hands. They are all very well observed and he has never once looked.

np_r1.line: "Fri. 19 Jul. 8.40 to 8.58. Sixth floor, 6B. Hinges sound. Draught at sill, slight, comes and goes." You may hold it by the edges. I go up most nights. It is not my door.

choices.label: What else is on that line?
You were on that landing minutes before she fell.

np_r2.line: "8.52. 6B set: a ferry. 6C wall: a clock. Not in agreement. 6C in: light under, door shut." I noted it as a fault in the party wall. One floor ought not to have two plays on it. The door did not open while I stood there, and at 8.58 I went down.

np_r3.line: I was. It has been written up. The draught is taken at the sill, with the back of the hand. I cannot very well knock. I don't mean it unkindly.
